driverAllowance.title: Driver allowance
driverAllowance.hint: Amount paid per trip day when the driver has no allowance of their own on file. Reverting to the default restores R$ 200.00.

federalTaxes.title: Federal regime
federalTaxes.hint: The trip valuation deducts PIS and COFINS from revenue at these rates. The suggestion comes from the CRT and the law; confirm with the accountant before saving.
federalTaxes.simpleNote: Under Simples Nacional, PIS and COFINS are paid inside the DAS: there is no separate rate to deduct from the trip margin.
federalTaxes.realNote: Under actual profit the suggested rates are the nominal ones (1.65% and 7.60%). Non-cumulative credits lower the effective rate — the accountant adjusts it.
federalTaxes.error: Could not save the federal regime ({{code}}).

contacts.title: Contacts and social
contacts.hint: Shown in the site footer and in automated emails. List order is display order.
contacts.invalidPhone: Phone needs area code and 10 to 13 digits.
contacts.invalidUrl: The address must start with https://

occurrenceTypeCatalog.title: Occurrence types
occurrenceTypeCatalog.hint: Each type declares in which moments it can be logged and what proof it requires. The tax-ID exception overrides the general rule: recipient first, then contractor. The contractor alert only goes out for checked types.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.empty: No type registered yet. Register the first one to be able to log occurrences.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.created: Type created. Set what it requires and its email below.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.saved: Settings saved. They apply to the next occurrences.

hiddenFields.itemsOff: Redelivery and “Accepts several items” only appear when Products is Optional or Required.
hiddenFields.separationOnly: “The trip proceeds without the invoice” only exists for types logged at the warehouse (Separator moment): on the road the invoice never leaves the trip.

occurrenceTypeCatalog.loadError: Could not load the occurrence types. The list may not be empty: try again.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.name: Type name
occurrenceTypeCatalog.withoutTemplate: No email: this type is only logged on the trip.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.itemsModeHint: No products: the occurrence carries no products — registration shows no selector, redelivery does not apply and Correct only appears on occurrences that already have products or were already corrected. Optional products: whoever registers may point at products.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.clientEmailTypeHint: Applies to the occurrence "Send to client" button. Off: the button is hidden and the API refuses the send. The other values pick which client e-mail type the button uses.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.asksClientContact: Ask the driver for the client contact
occurrenceTypeCatalog.asksClientContactHint: When the invoice client has no saved contact for this channel, the driver app asks for the WhatsApp number or e-mail when the occurrence is opened, so the driver does not have to send it in the chat. A client can have several numbers and e-mails.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.asksNewDueDate: Ask the driver for the new due date
occurrenceTypeCatalog.asksNewDueDateHint: The driver app shows the optional "New due date" field when the occurrence is opened (for example, when the client asks to extend a bill). When filled in, the date goes in the e-mail to the contractor; when blank, the e-mail goes out as usual.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.clientChannelHint: How the occurrence reaches the client. E-mail is the default and follows the e-mail type next to it. WhatsApp uses the client's number and, if it fails, the saved e-mail. Off sends nothing to the client.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.clientEmailSendModeHint: Manual: the boleto only goes out through the "Send to client" button. Automatic: once the boleto is accepted, it goes out on its own to every e-mail of this type in the client record (needs the e-mail subject and text filled in). With no e-mail on record, nothing is sent and the occurrence says so.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.duplicateRequestPolicy: Repeated request on the same invoice

duplicateRequestPolicyOptions.while_request_open: Block while the request is open
duplicateRequestPolicyOptions.until_resolved: Block until the occurrence is resolved or cancelled

occurrenceTypeCatalog.leavesDocumentBehind: The trip leaves without the document
occurrenceTypeCatalog.leavesDocumentBehindHint: Applies to a whole-document case. The document leaves the trip at dispatch.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.attachmentModeHint: Applies to the driver's record on the road. Required: the occurrence only goes with a photo and a note.
occurrenceTypeCatalog.flowHint: Which driver button this type feeds: by document (no queue, opens a case) or by stop (offline queue, never opens a case).

exceptions.title: Exceptions by client
exceptions.intro: The exception overrides the type's general rule. On each field, Same as the type inherits what the type declares; the exception's photo is always declared.
exceptions.failed: The exceptions of the types could not be loaded. Each type's general rule still applies; reload the page to try again.
exceptions.clientPlaceholder: Search by name or tax ID…
exceptions.clientSearch: Search client by name or tax ID
exceptions.pickClientFirst: Choose the client to be able to add the exception.
exceptions.clientsTruncated: The client list may be incomplete: only the first 3000 active clients were loaded, and anyone left out cannot receive an exception.
exceptions.contractorsTruncated: The contractor list may be incomplete: only the first 3000 were loaded, and anyone left out cannot receive an exception.
exceptions.clientsFailed: The registered clients could not be loaded, so a recipient exception cannot be created now. An exception only accepts a registered client; reload the page to try again.
exceptions.contractorsFailed: The contractors could not be loaded, so a contractor exception cannot be created now. Reload the page to try again.
exceptions.allClientsUsed: There is no registered client without an exception on this type.
exceptions.recordNote: The exception changes only the number and amount-paid requirements. Labels and e-mail belong to the type.
exceptions.itemsMinimumBlocked: The minimum number of products only applies when Products is Required on this exception.
exceptions.readOnly: No permission to change the exceptions.
exceptions.noEffect: This exception has no effect while the type does not apply to this contractor. It stays saved.

requirements.title: What it requires
requirements.legend: Required means the occurrence is not registered without it. Photo is the image captured on the device; Note is the driver's text; Signature is the one from whoever refused; Products are the invoice items the occurrence points to.
requirements.mixedScope: The requirements below apply only when the driver registers (Driver, on an invoice and Driver, at the stop). At the warehouse the rule is fixed.
requirements.stopOnlyScope: With Driver, at the stop only the photo is required: note, signature and products apply with Driver, on an invoice.

hints.photo: Applies to the driver's registration on the road. Off: no photo asked. Optional: the driver may attach one. Required: the occurrence is only sent with the minimum number of photos.
hints.note: Off: the note field is hidden. Optional: the driver may write. Required: the occurrence is only sent with the text filled in.
hints.signature: Off: no signature asked. Optional: the driver may collect the one from whoever refused. Required: the occurrence is only sent with the signature drawn.
hints.items: Off: the occurrence carries no products — registration hides the selector, redelivery does not apply and Correct only shows on occurrences that already have products or were already corrected. Optional: whoever registers may pick products. Required: the occurrence is only sent with a product picked.
hints.referenceNumber: Off: the registration screen does not ask. Optional: it asks and accepts empty. Required: the register button only enables with the number filled in (e.g. the store's return invoice).
hints.declaredAmount: Off: the screen does not show it. Optional: it shows and accepts empty. Required: the register button only enables filled in. With no typed amount, the invoice's calculated sum applies.

record.referenceLabel: Number label on the registration screen
record.amountLabel: Amount label on the registration screen
record.scope: Where the amount paid is typed
record.amountWithoutItems: An amount paid per line needs products: with Products off there is no line to type it on. Choose "One for the whole occurrence" under Typed, or turn Products on. Nothing was saved.

photoMinimum.label: Minimum number of photos
photoMinimum.hint: Only applies when the photo is required. From 1 to 5.

itemsMinimum.label: Products required
itemsMinimum.hint: Only applies when Products is Required. All invoice items suits a total refusal: the driver app only enables the registration with every product ticked. At least N enables it with N products ticked.
itemsMinimum.allItemsHint: With no minimum, the driver must mark every product on the invoice. Set "At least N" to accept a partial return.

mail.title: Contractor e-mail
mail.switch: Send an e-mail to the invoice's contractor when registered

template.label: Template
template.failed: Could not load the templates. Try again shortly.
template.missing: Type without a notification template: the email to the contractor is not sent. Choose a template.
template.unusable: The template "{{key}}" cannot be used for the email to the contractor, so no email is sent: {{problems}}
template.hint: The email text is written in Notifications → Preferences, in a Portuguese email template. Here you only choose which one.

problems.not_found: There is no active Portuguese email template with this key.
problems.system_key: It is a system notice, with other variables.
problems.unsafe_html: The HTML body has active content (script, iframe, event, javascript: address or a variable inside a tag); the email is not sent.
problems.missing_message_area: The HTML template needs exactly one message area, between <!-- mensagem --> and <!-- /mensagem -->; the email is not sent.
problems.unknown_variables: Variables outside the list come out empty: {{variables}}.

variables.razaoSocial: Legal name of the invoice recipient.
variables.itens: The items in one text, comma separated.
variables.linhasItens: One line per item: code – item – quantity unit – R$ value.
variables.cnpjContratante: Contractor CPF or CNPJ; empty without a document.
variables.assinaturaNome: Name of who signs the e-mail, or the team.
variables.assinaturaCargo: Job title of who signs; empty without a title or role.
variables.logoTransportadora: Carrier logo, or its initials without a logo (system HTML).
variables.tabelaItens: Item table with the total, up to 200 lines (system HTML).
variables.assinaturaIniciais: Initials of who signs, or of the display name.
variables.faixaResposta: "Reply to this e-mail" strip, only when replies arrive (system HTML).
variables.marcasRodape: Footer marks: TransportAdA and Ada Technology (system HTML).
variables.logoAssinatura: Signature square: the carrier logo on the team signature, otherwise the initials (system HTML).
variables.novaDataVencimento: New due date requested by the driver (DD/MM/YYYY); empty when not given.
variables.avisoNovaData: Paragraph "New due date requested: DD/MM/YYYY", only when the driver gave the date (system HTML).

watchers.failed: Could not load the company watchers.

notification.title: Internal notice
notification.templateHint: A notice to whoever dispatched the trip, through the Notifications module. The text is edited under Notifications; here you only pick which template applies. The contractor e-mail is set in the block above.
notification.subject: Subject:
notification.disabledReason: The template only applies when the type notifies whoever dispatched the trip. Turn on "Notify when it happens" to choose one.
notification.failed: Could not load the e-mail templates. The current template still applies; reload the page to try again.
notification.missing: The template "{{key}}" is no longer active, so no e-mail goes out through it. Choose another template.

filters.title: Type filters
filters.searchPlaceholder: Search by type name, or by name / tax ID of whoever has an exception
filters.exceptionUnavailable: The Has exception filter is unavailable until the exceptions load.
filters.emptyReasonQuery: No type has that name, and nobody with an exception has that name or tax ID: "{{query}}".
filters.emptyReasonPills_one: 1 filter is on and no type meets it.

contractorReply.title: Contractor reply
contractorReply.legend: The request goes to the contractor; when they answer with the updated boleto, the system can pass the reply to the driver without going through the operator.

fields.attachmentKind: Attachment that counts as the reply
fields.resolveOnDelivery: Close the occurrence by itself after delivering to the driver
fields.forwardToNoteRecipient: Send the boleto to the invoice customer email
fields.forwardToInformedEmail: Forward the boleto to an informed email
fields.forwardEmailSubject: Subject of the email to the third party
fields.forwardEmailBody: Text of the email to the third party

mode.forward_after_approval: Pass to the driver after operator approval

attachmentKind.boleto_pdf: Checked boleto PDF (payment line and note)

contractorReply.forwardLegend: The same subject and text go to the invoice customer and to the informed email, with the boleto attached. Up to 5 emails per occurrence.

problems.needsContractorMail: Turn on the contractor email for this type to use the reply.
problems.templateRequired: Write the text the driver receives.
problems.alertNeedsWaitHours: To alert on delay, enter the wait time.
problems.automaticNeedsReply: Automatic sending to the invoice customer requires the reply to be on.
problems.forwardNeedsText: Write the subject and the text: the email to the third party is not sent without both.

acknowledgement.empty: Add an active quick reply on the Contractor tab to pick it here.
acknowledgement.hint: Sent once per conversation, only when the document is confirmed and delivered to the driver without the operation stepping in.

contractorScope.title: Applies to
contractorScope.searchPlaceholder: Search by name or tax ID
contractorScope.truncated: The contractor list may be incomplete: only the first 3000 were loaded, and anyone left out cannot be chosen.
contractorScope.pending: Change to Applies to not applied yet — click Apply for it to take effect.
contractorScope.note: A restricted type is only offered, to the driver and to the office, on notes from a contractor in the list. A note from an unregistered contractor gets only the all-contractor types. What was already recorded stays visible.
contractorScope.stopOnly: A stop has no contractor: this type applies to all of them.
contractorScope.stopAllContractors: On a stop this type applies to all contractors; the restriction applies to records with a note.

settingsResolution.title: Check effective configuration
settingsResolution.hint: Pick a contractor and/or a recipient to see the delivery proof and, for each occurrence type, the photo, the note, the signature, the products and the minimum photos and products that apply to that combination, with the layer that decided each one — the same computation the driver app would make.
settingsResolution.contractorPlaceholder: Search by name or tax id
settingsResolution.generalHint: With no contractor or recipient chosen, shows the general configuration (no exception).
settingsResolution.error: Could not load the effective configuration.

whatsappEvolution.title: WhatsApp through Evolution
whatsappEvolution.hint: Connect the company number by scanning a QR code. Without a connected number, WhatsApp sending stays off and the system uses email.
whatsappEvolution.baseUrlHint: Full address, starting with https:// (or http:// on the Railway private network).
whatsappEvolution.apiKeyKeep: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
whatsappEvolution.risk: Warning: Evolution uses the WhatsApp Web protocol, which Meta does not authorize. The number can be banned and a WhatsApp change can stop sending until the package is updated. It is a free option, not the guaranteed path: email stays the default and the fallback.
whatsappEvolution.acknowledgeRisk: I read the warning and accept the risk of the number being banned.
whatsappEvolution.providerHint: New sends use the chosen provider; old ones keep the provider they went out with. Evolution can only be the default while the channel is on.

connection.needsEnabled: Save the settings with the key and turn the channel on to connect the number.
connection.qrAlt: QR code to connect the number on WhatsApp
connection.qrHint: On the phone: WhatsApp, Linked devices, Link a device. The code renews itself until the number connects.
connection.qrError: Could not get the QR ({{code}}). Trying again.
connection.checkError: Could not read the connection state ({{code}}).
connection.dropped: The number is disconnected. Generate a new QR to reconnect; meanwhile sends fall back to email.
connection.title: Number connection
connection.qrWaiting: Generating the QR code. This can take a few seconds.
